key.name: event-count
key.description: How many upcoming appointments the list shows.

key.name: lookahead-days
key.description: How far ahead the extension asks the calendar server for appointments. Widened automatically when the window does not contain enough entries.

key.name: show-all-day
key.description: When disabled, only timed appointments are listed.

key.name: open-calendar-on-click
key.description: Clicking the appointment list opens GNOME Calendar.

key.name: hide-calendar-grid
key.description: Hides the month grid in the date menu, leaving the appointment list. The day header stays.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Logs which appointments were rendered and which window was requested, for troubleshooting (journalctl --user -u org.gnome.Shell.desktop -f).
